import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import pytorch_lightning as pl
import torch
from pytorch_lightning.loggers import MLFlowLogger
from pytorch_lightning.strategies import DDPStrategy
from pytorch_lightning.callbacks import LearningRateMonitor
from torch import Generator

import doc_octopy
from doc_octopy.datasets.kinematics_and_emg.as_2D import KinematicsEMGDataset__3D_Points
from doc_octopy.models.definitions.raul_net.offline.v4 import CNNApproximator
from doc_octopy.utils.ml_helpers import (
    save_log_mlflow,
    save_model_mlflow,
    save_train_and_def_mlflow,
)
from doc_octopy.utils.constants import EXPERIMENTS_TO_USE

torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True
# torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(mode=True, warn_only=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Training script for the AI model from Sîmpetru et al.",
        formatter_class=argparse.ArgumentDefaultsHelpFormatter,
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--seed",
        "-s",
        type=int,
        default=1801211219,
        help="Seed to be used.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--experimentee",
        "-e",
        default="ERROR",
        help="Experimentee / Subject to be used.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--rectify",
        default=0,
        type=int,
        help="Set to 1 to rectify EMG.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--df_cutoff_freq",
        default=None,
        type=int,
        help="Data filter cutoff frequency in Hz",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--sf_cutoff_freq",
        default=None,  # set this value to generate dataset with depth 2 for testing purposes
        type=int,
        help="Supplementary filter cutoff frequency in Hz",
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    chunk_size__samples = 192
    distance_between_chunks__samples = 64
    epochs = 25
    batch_size = 64
    seed = args.seed
    generator = Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    precision = 32
    subject = args.experimentee

    pl.seed_everything(seed, workers=True)

    dataset = KinematicsEMGDataset__3D_Points(
        raw_data_path=Path("../../..", "data", "kinematics_and_emg_new", subject),
        processed_data_path=list(Path("../../../../../scratchssd").resolve().glob("*"))[-1],
        run_preprocess=False,
        chunk_size__samples=chunk_size__samples,
        distance_between_chunks__samples=distance_between_chunks__samples,
        data_filter_cutoff_freq__hz=20,
        data_filter_order=4,
        supplementary_filter_cutoff_freq__hz=None,
        run_splitting=False,
        seed=seed,
        experiments_to_use=EXPERIMENTS_TO_USE,
        experiment_to_use_as_test=None,
        dataloader_parameters={
            "batch_size": batch_size,
            "pin_memory": False,
            "generator": generator,
            "num_workers": 16,
            "persistent_workers": True,
            "drop_last": True,
        },
        shuffle_channels=False,
        shuffle_training_data=True,
    )
    dataset.prepare_data()

    emg_example, _ = next(dataset.train_dataloader().__iter__())
    model = CNNApproximator(
        learning_rate=1e-4,
        nr_of_input_channels=1 if args.sf_cutoff_freq is None else 2,
        input_length__samples=chunk_size__samples,
        nr_of_outputs=60,
        cnn_encoder_channels=(256, 32, 64),
        mlp_encoder_channels=(512, 512),
        event_search_kernel_length=31,
        event_search_kernel_stride=8,
    )

    logger = MLFlowLogger(
        experiment_name=f"3D_points_{bool(args.rectify)}_{args.df_cutoff_freq}_{args.sf_cutoff_freq}",
        tracking_uri="file:./mlruns",
        run_name=f"{subject} {str(seed)}",
    )

    trainer = pl.Trainer(
        accelerator="gpu",
        devices=-1,
        strategy=DDPStrategy(
            find_unused_parameters=False,
            static_graph=True,
            gradient_as_bucket_view=True,
        ),
        precision=precision,
        max_epochs=epochs,
        log_every_n_steps=25,
        logger=logger,
        enable_checkpointing=False,
        deterministic=False,
        check_val_every_n_epoch=1,
        callbacks=[LearningRateMonitor(log_momentum=True)],
        gradient_clip_val=1.0,
        # detect_anomaly=True,
        # max_time="00:3:45:00",
    )

    if trainer.is_global_zero:
        save_train_and_def_mlflow(
            logger=logger,
            train_file_path=Path(__file__).absolute(),
            def_file_path=Path(doc_octopy.models.definitions.raul_net.offline.raul_net_v4.__file__).absolute(),
        )

    trainer.fit(model, datamodule=dataset)
    trainer.test(model, datamodule=dataset)

    if trainer.is_global_zero:
        save_model_mlflow(logger=logger, trainer=trainer, input_example=emg_example)
        logger.log_hyperparams(
            {
                "criterion": model.criterion,
                "epochs": model.current_epoch,
                "chunk size": chunk_size__samples,
                "distance between chunks": distance_between_chunks__samples,
                "seed": seed,
                "batch size": batch_size,
                "precision": precision,
                "activation function": "SMU",
                "subject": subject,
            }
        )
        save_log_mlflow(logger=logger)
